'''Natalie''' (Japanese: '''ナオコ''' ''Naoko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG012|The Lotad Lowdown]]''. She runs the [[Pretty Petal flower shop]] with her two older sisters {{OBP|Rita|AG012}} and [[Nicole]].

When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were playing at the nearby lake with the {{p|Lotad}}, Natalie demanded they come with her to get lectured for trespassing. But instead of them being lectured, she got scolded by Nicole for being rude to the travelers. When Natalie saw how {{an|Brock}} treated her sisters with more kindness, she became jealous, having developed a crush on him.

Afterwards, wherever Brock went, Natalie was always next to him, willing to do whatever Brock wanted or needed. Natalie's infatuation for Brock also got her into trouble when she decided to search for a [[Sitrus Berry]] by herself, thinking that it would help Brock achieve his goal as a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}}. After finding a Sitrus Berry, Natalie suddenly got attacked by a {{p|Beedrill}}. Brock came to the rescue and saved Natalie from danger.

As Brock and his friends prepared to leave, Natalie gave Brock a list of {{Berries}} and their effects on Pokémon, keeping her earlier promise.

She was mentioned by Brock in ''[[AG117|Berry, Berry Interesting]]'', who revealed that he still had the book she gave him.
